source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-206–210 were reviewed for non-universal stretch claims, asynchronous male anthesis, pollen assay interpretation, long-range transport without fixed isolation-distance claims, and stigma appearance versus physiological receptivity. Public wording separates visible reproductive structures from functional viability, fertilization, and seed-set evidence.
source.note: This batch connects floral development to pollen biology and female receptivity using measurement-first, evidence-bounded reproductive science.
